lines.text: Every child grows up one moment at a time.
Child Life is here to walk alongside your family,
starting with the very first year.
Life with a little one is full of firsts.
And a lot to keep track of.
The last feed.
The next nap.
The little updates you share so everyone knows how the day is going.
And somewhere between it all,
another first happens.
A smile.
A sound.
A moment you want to remember.
Meet Child Life.
A shared space for caring for your child, and keeping their story close.
Log a feed in a tap,
from a home-screen widget, your Apple Watch, or just by asking Siri.
So whoever looks after your little one next can pick up where you left off.
Or just tell Lumi what happened,
it drafts the log for you to check.
And each day brings ideas that fit your child's age,
with reminders right when they matter.
Follow the little changes.
Celebrate the firsts.
And bring your family along as your child grows.
Turn everyday photos into keepsakes you can return to,
because the days you're living now
are the memories you'll treasure later.
Less to keep track of.
More to hold on to.
Child Life.
Growing together, every step of the way.
